answer: Unrepeatable answer challenge. Each agent identity must answer a fresh random challenge derived from live system state, and the reply is checked against that exact round; a copied reply fails because the round moves on. A pearl of verified work proves effort, while slow-mixing shale proves sustained participation. Costs scale as karst resists erosion: repeated identities must redo costly per-round computation, so farm size multiplies attacker compute and time linearly.
